neighbours.label: An item someone is wearing or carrying when they enter a scene: ' towel' (wrapped around the body), 'with a letter'
fire: He stepped out of the shower with a towel wrapped around his hips.
She opened the door wearing only a towel around her body.
Enter the messenger, with a letter for the queen.
He came downstairs in a towel, still dripping from the bath.
The maid walked in with a letter on a silver tray.
Wrapped in a towel, she hurried across the cold bathroom.
He stood by the sink wearing just a towel and humming.
The boy ran in with a letter from his father.
quiet: He stepped out of the shower and dried his hair quickly.
She opened the door wearing a coat and a red scarf.
Enter the messenger, out of breath from the long ride.
He came downstairs in a hurry, still angry about the call.
The maid walked in and set the table for dinner.
Shivering slightly, she hurried across the cold bathroom.
He stood by the sink shaving and humming.
The boy ran in shouting about the storm.
